short: The screenshot walker over the built Storybook
is: Playwright Test over the built Storybook (`storybook-static`), run only inside the pinned Playwright image: the walker opens every story and docs entry of `index.json` in Paper dark and Paper light with motion stopped, fails it on a request off 127.0.0.1, a page error or Storybook's error display, then compares it with its reference picture; with its static loopback server, its image guard and the self-tests that prove each check catches what it should.
conventions: Runs only inside the pinned image, through `scripts/gallery-shots.sh`: the config calls `imageGuard()` first, which refuses unless `ZURFUR_GALLERY_IMAGE` is `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v<version>-noble@sha256:<digest>`, the image's marker `/ms-playwright/.docker-info` names that version and image, and the installed `@playwright/test` is that version. It guards against accidents only. On the host, `playwright test --config shots/playwright.config.ts` refuses before any test.

Inside the container the work directory is `/work/frontend/ui`, with no network: read-only `storybook-static`, `shots`, `package.json` and `frontend/node_modules`; read-write `shots/output` (fresh and empty each run) and, on an update run only, `shots/__screenshots__`; `HOME=/tmp`, `TZ=UTC`, `/tmp` the only other writable place. The source is not mounted, so nothing here imports from outside `shots/` but packages from `frontend/node_modules`, and `tsconfig.json` here stands alone (no `extends`).

Two projects: `stories` (the walker, the manager-page test and the stale-picture test) and `self` (the self-tests). A plain run is `playwright test --config shots/playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots=none`; an update run adds `--update-snapshots=changed --project=stories` and is the only way a reference picture is made.

References live at `__screenshots__/<entry id>/<dark|light>.png` and are made only through the image. An entry id is parsed (`^[a-z0-9-]+$`) before it names a picture, else its test fails; a folder or file there that names no shot entry or skin fails the stale-picture test; `src/checks/references.ts` and its spec hold the folder to that layout and each picture to a plain PNG of at most 1 MiB and 4096 px a side, with no text, time or Exif chunk.

Each test checks requests, page errors and Storybook's state before `toHaveScreenshot`, which comes last, so an update run never keeps a picture from a failed test. Every request not to `http://127.0.0.1:5199`, `data:` or `blob:` is aborted and fails the test, in every frame, as does any off-host websocket. Storybook's state is read from the preview: the body class `sb-show-errordisplay` or `sb-show-nopreview` fails it; a story is rendered once every story render reached its `finished` phase (play and afterEach included), a docs page once Storybook's `docsRendered` event fired and its stories finished; the globals the address set (`globals=skin:<skin>;motion:still`) must be the preview's.

Tags: `no-shot` skips an entry (and its pictures then count as stale); `phone-320` shoots it at 320×568, Storybook's `mobile1`. Everything else is shot at 1280×900, scale 1, `en-GB`, UTC, reduced motion, the page's colour scheme matching the skin, viewport only (token pages too, not the full page).

Settings: threshold 0.2 with no differing pixel, animations disabled, caret hidden, CSS scale; no retries, flaky tests fail, `test.only` refused, four workers, trace, video and failure screenshots off, no html reporter, git info not captured. Failures keep Playwright's expected, actual and difference pictures under `output/results`.

`yarn test:shots` runs the Node tests here (`*.test.mjs`, `*.test.ts`) on the host; `yarn check` type-checks this folder with `tsc -p shots/tsconfig.json`. `output/` is ignored by git and prettier, `__screenshots__/` by prettier.

fs.name: image-guard.test.ts
fs.role: Node test of the guard: each refusal and a clean pass

fs.name: image-guard.ts
fs.role: imageGuardRefusals (pure, over the pin, the marker's text and the installed version) and imageGuard, which reads them and throws one error naming every refusal

fs.name: playwright.config.ts
fs.role: the guard first, the two projects, the settings, the snapshot paths and the web server on 127.0.0.1:5199

fs.name: self/
fs.role: the self-tests (project self): a missing reference fails, an off-host request, websocket and page error are caught in the page and a nested frame, Storybook's error display is caught, the guard refuses outside the image

fs.name: serve.mjs
fs.role: the static server, Node built-ins only: one folder on 127.0.0.1, GET and HEAD only, the target decoded once, NUL, backslash, `..` and any real path outside the folder refused, `/` as index.html, no listing, nosniff

fs.name: serve.test.mjs
fs.role: Node test of the server: traversal by every route refused, files, HEAD, 404, 405 and the loopback bind

fs.name: stories.pw.ts
fs.role: the walker (project stories), the manager-page test and the stale-picture test

fs.name: storybook.ts
fs.role: index.json parsed into entries (each id parsed, else refused), the skins, the tags, the viewports, the entry address and the stale-picture walk

fs.name: tsconfig.json
fs.role: a standalone strict config for this folder, type-checked by `yarn check`

fs.name: watch.ts
fs.role: the checks the walker and the self-tests share: the loopback port, the request, websocket and page-error watch, Storybook's render state, settling and the globals check
